title: Special Executive Master Programme In Operations and Project Management
description: Enhance your expertise in operations and Project management to drive efficiency and effectiveness in business activities.
longDescription: The Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Operations and Project Management offers advanced training in innovative project methodologies and strategic leadership tailored for senior professionals. This program empowers participants to efficiently lead complex projects and drive organizational success through cutting-edge management techniques. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The Special Executive Master Programme in Project Management allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The program effectively prepares learners to tackle complex operational challenges by integrating theoretical knowledge with practical applications.
courseDetails: The aim of the Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Project Management is to equip executives with advanced skills in strategic planning, execution, and leadership to drive successful project outcomes. The program emphasizes innovative methodologies and decision-making techniques to enhance efficiency and foster sustainable growth in dynamic environments. Course Details: Planning, Controlling, and Leading a Project: Provides learners with the expertise to strategize, monitor, and guide projects to successful completion. Procurement Risk and Contract Management: Emphasizes risk mitigation and optimization of procurement processes through effective contract management. Advanced Project and Logistics Management: Delves into advanced techniques to enhance efficiency and streamline project and logistics operations. Operations and Information Management for Project Managers: Offers insights into managing project operations and information flow for seamless execution. Advanced Research Methods: Enhances proficiency in research methodologies critical for project analysis, decision-making, and innovation. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) After completing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project (GP) integrating knowledge from all modules. This project assesses their ability to apply current practices in Project management and solidifies their comprehensive understanding of the field. Programme Structure and Credits:

modules.title: MANAGEMENT INFORMATION SYSTEM
modules.summary: This module explores the design, implementation, and strategic use of Management Information Systems to support business decision-making. It examines how MIS integrates people, processes, and technology to manage data effectively. Students will learn about system components, databases, and decision support systems. The module also covers emerging trends such as cloud computing and data analytics. By the end, learners will understand how MIS enhances organizational efficiency and competitiveness.

lessons.title: Appraising Information Systems and Organisation Strategy
Identifying Information Systems and Information Technology
Understanding the Role of MIS in Decision Making, System Design, and Modeling
Recognizing Information Systems Development and Globalisation

modules.title: OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: This course is an introduction to the concepts, principles, problems, and practices of operations management. Emphasis is on managerial processes for effective operations in both goods-producing and service-rendering organization. Topics include operations strategy, process design, capacity planning, facilities location and design, forecasting, production scheduling, inventory control, quality assurance, and project management. The topics are integrated using a systems model of the operations of an organization.

lessons.title: Role of Operations in Business Activities

modules.title: PLANNING, CONTROLLING AND LEADING PROJECTS
modules.summary: This module provides an in-depth understanding of project management principles with a focus on planning, controlling, and leading projects to successful completion. It covers key areas such as project initiation, scope definition, scheduling, resource allocation, and risk management. Students will explore leadership strategies for motivating teams and managing stakeholder expectations. Emphasis is placed on monitoring progress, maintaining quality, and adapting to change. The module equips learners with the tools and techniques needed to deliver projects effectively in dynamic environments.

modules.title: SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The aim of the programme is to provide postgraduate-level education in operations and supply chain management principles, theories and practice. This unit introduces the concepts of logistics and supply chain management. In the modern global marketplace, companies need to be efficient in relation to the movement of supplies and delivery of the final products. The unit explores issues in relation to logistics including value, managing lead time and techniques including just-in-time, and incorporating the role of technology in this process.

lessons.title: Supply Chain Planning Models and Approaches

modules.title: OPERATIONS AND INFORMATION MANAGEMENT FOR PROJECT MANAGERS
modules.summary: This module examines how effective operations and information management contribute to successful project delivery. It focuses on aligning operational strategies with project objectives, ensuring efficient resource utilization and workflow optimization. Students will explore tools and systems used for information tracking, performance measurement, and decision-making. The module emphasizes the integration of data-driven insights to enhance productivity and manage project risks. By the end, learners will be equipped to streamline operations and leverage information systems for improved project outcomes.

After completing the course, students will be able to prepare a research plan, collect data, address research questions and hypotheses, and organize a project report.
